The basic saving flow feels right: one link and one click is exactly the speed I want, and newest-first is a sensible starting order.

The saved entry needs a little more, though. I’d expect the app to use the page’s real title and, when available, show its description, site icon, and preview image—not make a title from the address. I should be able to correct the title and description both while saving and afterward. The title or entry itself should open the original page; the full address can still appear underneath.

One important saving case is duplicates: if I paste a link I’ve already saved, please take me to the existing entry so I can edit it instead of adding another copy.
